editorial:
You follow Kid, a quiet young man who fights in an underground club wearing a gorilla mask, getting beaten bloody for cash night after night. He has a dark past and a deep grudge against the city's powerful elite who ruined his life. When he finally finds a way inside their world, his bottled-up rage explodes into a violent mission of revenge. The whole movie has a gritty, intense vibe that pulls you in from the start.

Dev Patel not only stars but also directs, and his performance is raw and powerful. The action scenes are brutal and well-shot, with a style that feels fresh and exciting. On the downside, the story can feel a bit familiar if you have seen revenge thrillers before, and some scenes move slowly. Still, if you love action-packed revenge stories with heart, this one is for you.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Kid confronts the corrupt leaders who destroyed his family, including the police chief and the spiritual leader. After a brutal showdown, he kills them and frees the oppressed people they controlled. The movie ends with Kid walking away, his mission complete, leaving behind the broken system. It is a satisfying, violent conclusion that ties up his revenge story.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge thrillers and brutal action movies.
